power_and_precision_plan.basis: Phase 17's own 25 candidates x 120 boards x 2 lanes of per-case paired outcomes, reports/phase17/local_eval/rows/
power_and_precision_plan.method: analytic paired two-sided z at alpha 0.05 and power 0.80, cross-checked by a deterministic bootstrap that resamples the empirical paired-difference pool (type-I measured at 0.048)

own_setup_instrument.definition: joint_move_setup minus move_only at the same candidate and board: same move weights, only the player's own setup differs - the exact shape of C0-L minus C0-F and T-L minus T-F

move_instrument.definition: candidate_k minus candidate_0 in the move_only lane: same own-setup source, only move weights differ - the shape of T-F minus C0-F

critical_finding.statement: pairing across lanes buys far less than it appears to. The within-candidate correlation between the two lanes on the same board is only 0.238, so the paired difference sd (0.5391) is LARGER than either lane's own sd (0.4236). Pairing reduces variance by about 24% against fully unpaired, not by the order of magnitude that near-perfect pairing would give.
critical_finding.consequence: a 120-game lane has a minimum detectable effect of 0.1379 EWR at 80% power. Phase 17's evaluation could not have resolved anything smaller. Its 'flat' joint lane and its '0 of 24 candidates beat hour 0' reading are both consistent with any true effect inside roughly plus or minus 0.13 EWR.
critical_finding.cross_check: this reproduces Agent 1's independently measured 0.1435 EWR pure-noise spread for 25 candidates on a 120-game lane.

predeclared_practical_margins.scope: every Gate G3 and G4 effective-win-rate contrast
predeclared_practical_margins.basis: 0.05 EWR is the smallest margin that (a) is resolvable at a per-contrast cost of about 1,000 paired games, which is roughly 8x a Phase 17 lane and affordable at the measured throughput, and (b) exceeds the 0.0503 MDE at that size. A 0.03 margin would need about 2535 games per contrast and a 0.02 margin about 5703.

worst_stratum_power.finding: at 12 games a per-opponent stratum has a minimum detectable effect of about 0.436 EWR, which is not a measurement. Phase 17's reported worst-stratum figures (for example 0.125 on phase9_anchor over 12 games) carry no information.
worst_stratum_power.requirement: a stratum may only be reported as a worst-stratum REGRESSION if it carries at least 200 paired games; below that it is reported as descriptive with its n and explicitly labelled underpowered

power_and_precision_plan.note_on_scope: these sizes are for effective-win-rate contrasts. Head-metric contrasts on the 4,000-game sealed Phase 8 test are far better powered and are not the binding constraint.

evaluator_credibility_requirements.R1: identical deterministic results across every supported worker count, proved by an identical result digest
evaluator_credibility_requirements.R2: a forced worker failure is retried without duplicating or substituting any outcome
evaluator_credibility_requirements.R3: a missing result is recorded `missing` and a failed result `failed`; neither is ever scored as a draw
evaluator_credibility_requirements.R4: exact case, seed, colour, opponent and setup accounting: planned equals completed plus missing plus failed, with no unexplained rows
evaluator_credibility_requirements.R5: no setup or opponent orientation drift: every setup is orientation-gated at every use and a failure is fatal
evaluator_credibility_requirements.R6: lane isolation: changing own setup cannot change move weights or the opponent case, proved by a fixture that varies one factor and asserts the other's inputs are bit-identical
evaluator_credibility_requirements.R7: model and setup digest refusal on any mismatch
evaluator_credibility_requirements.R8: a sealed pack cannot be opened by any training or pilot path, proved by an attempted access that is refused and recorded
evaluator_credibility_requirements.R9: REQUIRED REGRESSION CASE - the Phase 17 retry defect. In stratego/evaluation/phase17/evaluator.py, role_evaluate writes a refusal receipt to <candidate_id>.result.json; existing_result() (line 174) then finds that file on any later attempt, reads bundle_digest as None, and the identity check at line 221-230 refuses the candidate as duplicate-conflicting - permanently. A candidate that failed for a transient reason can never be re-evaluated without deleting the file by hand. The Phase 18 evaluator must pass a test that evaluates a candidate, forces a transient failure, and then successfully re-evaluates it with no manual file removal.
evaluator_credibility_requirements.R10: full result recomputation from immutable per-row receipts, reproducing the headline number exactly
evaluator_credibility_requirements.R11: reported before any sealed pack may be opened; a passing test list is not a substitute for the digests
